svg.title: Character CNN
svg.desc: Each of the four poem lines is normalized and mapped to character IDs (93 characters plus PAD and UNK). A 95 by 64 embedding with dropout feeds three parallel Conv1D branches with kernel sizes 3, 5 and 7, each with 64 channels, ReLU and masked max pooling over positions. The three 64-feature outputs are concatenated to 192 features. Dropout and a linear layer give four logits per line, a temperature-scaled softmax gives line probabilities, and their mean gives the poem prediction. 68,484 parameters in total.
svg.text: One shared line encoder scores each of the four lines; the poem label is the mean of the line distributions.
each line processed independently · shared weights
Unicode NFC · whitespace normalized · never truncated
T fitted on a held-out calibration split after checkpoint selection
L = characters per line · step 06 values are illustrative
